title: One exact viewpoint
description: White fragments painted across three black depth planes resolve into one divided ring at a precise viewpoint.
useCase: Reveal a geometric identity through spatial alignment, or explain how a viewpoint unifies separated artwork.
interaction: Drag the planes or use the Viewpoint range, then press Align to reach the registration point.
reducedMotion: Viewpoint changes remain direct; Align and near-target release snap immediately without camera travel.
limitations: Three original planar fragments with a horizontal analytic camera orbit. SVG represents perspective geometry; the small edge extrusion is illustrative, with no full 3D lighting, imported model, or free camera.
look: Three matte-black blades carry a sharp white divided ring against warm grey, with red registration crosshairs and a red alignment control.
motion: Direct dragging changes the camera yaw and projects each fragment at its own depth. At zero degrees, the silhouettes meet into one mark. Align eases from the current pose; interruption continues from the visible angle.
adapt: `project` inverse-maps the desired registered silhouette onto the depth planes and then applies camera yaw. Replace `OUTLINE`, `COUNTER`, and `CUT` with original paths; adjust `PLANES`, `planeSeparation`, `viewRange`, `snapRadius`, and `snapTime` to change the reveal.
